verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਨ੍ਹਾਤੈ ਪਾਪ ਜਾਨਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: teerath nhaatai paap jaan patit udhaaran naau dharaiaa|

en.bdb: Since the sins are obliterated at the pilgrimage centres, people have ven them the Name of uplifters of the fallen ones.
